initiatives.name: 7th St Collective
initiatives.description: a qtbipoc centered collective rooted in autonomous organizing & mutual aid.

initiatives.name: Care Culture Collaborative
initiatives.description: Long Beach anarchist and abolitionist group that serves hot meals on Saturdays at Bixby Park, hands out Narcan, fentanyl test strips and zines, and publishes a free-food directory and quarterly zine.

initiatives.name: Oral History and Popular Memory Project
initiatives.description: Long Beach immigrant-led organization (formerly the Long Beach Immigrant Rights Coalition) working on immigrant justice, economic justice, and food access and mutual aid for families.

initiatives.name: SURJ Long Beach
initiatives.description: Long Beach chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice, a group for white people in Long Beach to organize around racial and economic justice.

initiatives.name: Long Beach Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: Food, clothing, and hygiene distribution every Sunday.

initiatives.name: BlackLivesMatter #LBC
initiatives.description: Long Beach chapter of Black Lives Matter Grassroots. Works on housing justice and tenant organizing, and hosts community events and a podcast.

initiatives.name: LBC Tenants
initiatives.description: Tenant organizing group in Long Beach, CA, focused on stopping evictions and rent increases.
